name: GitHub REST API issues (read)
description: Read operation family of the GitHub REST Issues API (list and get issues).

provenance.notes: Supports API version 2026-03-10 (latest) and 'Issues' repository permissions (read) for List repository issues and Get an issue; public resources need no auth. required_scopes uses this project's notation '<fine-grained permission>:<access>' for the GitHub fine-grained token permission named on the endpoint page; auth_methods api_key represents a fine-grained personal access token (bearer token). OAuth app and GitHub App installation tokens were not verified today and are omitted.
Rate limits recorded in the note (5,000 req/h per user; 60 req/h unauthenticated; secondary 900 points/min, GET = 1 point).
